page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.32xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated vCPUs utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The processing power is delivered by Intel Xeon 8369B processors operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz.

This instance is equipped with 1024.0 GB of system memory, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external block storage volumes. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps.

Given its massive memory capacity and high vCPU count, the ecs.r7.32xlarge offers resource density suitable for enterprise-scale workloads. The qualitative cost efficiency is aligned with high-end memory-optimized hardware, where the lack of bundled local storage is offset by the large RAM allocation and dedicated CPU resources. This profile is suited for large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning systems, heavy data processing pipelines, and memory-intensive analytics workloads.
